metadata.datasource: KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA 160NC, 160VC, 400NC, 400VC, and 800 Films, publication E-190 (Eastman Kodak, 10/2006), p. 9: characteristic curves (Status M, C-41), spectral sensitivity (D 0.2 over D-min), spectral dye density (midscale neutral and D-min), digitised from the PDF's vector paths
metadata.copyright: SpektraLab product data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is read from one.
metadata.license: Built from Kodak publication E-190. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
metadata.method: spektrafilm's profile factory (9428440, GPL-3.0): D-min removed, speed point (green D 0.2) three stops under 0, C/M/Y dyes reconstructed from midscale neutral and D-min (dmid_dmin, generic starting dyes, masking couplers fitted), Status M unmixed, three normal CDFs per layer, D55 balance; then the shipped profiles' form reproduced from them: each dye at unit Status M density, sensitivity tails as an exponential approach, an sRGB 18 % grey at log exposure 0 through the engine (adaptation off), hanatos2025 window + surface fitted to Otsu, Munsell, UEF forest and Japan natural-object reflectances under D55, upstream's grey-ramp correction (Portra Endura, -2..+6 EV, trustability 1) run through the SpektraLab engine, mid-grey re-anchored.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET inside the plotted range; ASSUMED tails (exponential approach, the shipped Kodak rule); level FITTED (mid-grey -> 0)
tags.density_curves: SHEET (Status M, unmixed through the reconstructed dyes), FITTED (3 CDFs per layer, grey-ramp scale/shift); ASSUMED beyond the plotted exposures (the CDFs' own saturation)
tags.channel_density: FITTED to the sheet's midscale neutral minus D-min (dmid_dmin model)
tags.hanatos2025_adaptation: FITTED (reflectance sets above; the window's widths held at the shipped Kodak negatives' medians)
tags.info: SHEET: 135 on 0.13 mm acetate, 120 on 0.10 mm; ASSUMED antihalation strong (as Portra), D55 reference
